forward: Explicit coordinate/FP32-time control on the same saved students, under no_grad; see per-axis numeric definition. New AEE required, not training-final bit equivalence.
storage: Copy NPZ values into original training strides, including Conv2 V stride32 and live sourceA/d/P parameterization; preserve frozen parent and base projection bias plus separate delta.

coordinate_function.temporal_numeric: All time products FP32, TF32 disabled, including explicit native time control; channel policy is stated separately below.
coordinate_function.channel_numeric: Every F.conv2d inside this helper (both Conv2 factors, F, U/UF/V) uses cuDNN with TF32 disabled; all other cuDNN flags and helper-external arithmetic are preserved.
coordinate_function.constants: BN fold and UF compile in FP32; As inverse and ordinary C compile in Float64 then roundFP32, no entry thresholding.
coordinate_function.shared_readout: Actual saved d64 multiplies selected FP32 coordinates in Float64 then roundsFP32; no rounded-A correction.
coordinate_function.ranges: Per-frame per-T max_abs from actual intermediate tensors only. Native does not materialize unbiased Q or AZ; native source/consumer membrane and PED latent are recorded instead.
coordinate_function.claim: New FP32 reassociation requires fresh AEE. No native bit-equivalence, buffer deletion, operator skipping or GPU-speed claim.

preview_coordinate_function.source: Actual theta*g input and saved dequantized U8 coefficients; no extra theta multiplication, code conversion or source change.
preview_coordinate_function.bias_center: Use exactly the current adapter's effective pair.temporal.b. Its old native leaf A/b/center is overridden and is not applied again.
preview_coordinate_function.execution: Z=conv(source,U_live); AZ is the full noncausal sparse A2 dot; raw=conv(AZ,V_live); original fixed norm1(raw); sn2 margin=(norm1(raw)+(A2*1-1)*beta1)+pair.b-theta; HardThetaGate.
preview_coordinate_function.temporal_numeric: A2 sparse rows multiply FP32 Z with TF32 disabled. No causal restriction or approximate zero threshold. Intermediate products/sums and BN correction are FP32.
preview_coordinate_function.channel_numeric: Both Conv1-factor convolutions in this helper disable cuDNN TF32 and preserve other flags; the original BN and helper-external operators retain their policies.

temporal_products_per_spatial_position.scope: Both sides grant static A sparsity; counts are arithmetic opportunity, not GPU kernel work or cycles.

correction_cost.scope: This literal forward retains native BN then adds the compiled10xH correction. Temporal bias addition and theta subtraction also execute; no free correction claim.

preview_coordinate_function.external_calls: Original fixed norm1, Conv2, BN2, identity/shortcut, PED and real successors still execute. No intermediate tensor removal is claimed.
preview_coordinate_function.ranges: Per-frame actual per-T max_abs of Z, AZ, VAZ, fixed norm1 output and sn2 margin; no full tensor trace.
preview_coordinate_function.claim: Ordinary linear compilation baseline available to every axis. New FP32 function needs its own AEE; no independent innovation or saved-cycle assertion.

evaluation.claim: Dense function/accuracy check; elapsed time is not a speed comparison

training_final_alignment.scope: New coordinate/FP32-time function versus old training-final arithmetic; differences are expected, not an exact reload failure.
